scheme_name: Grant Of Incentive For Marriage Between Differently Abled Person And Normal Persons
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native/resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry
Applicant must have a disability of 40% or more
The marriage must be the first marriage for both bride and groom
Application must be submitted within 120 days after marriage
benefits_summary: An incentive of ₹1,00,000, comprising ₹20,000 in cash and ₹80,000 in National Savings Certificate.
